correctness.rationale: Exhaustive metric-face model has exactly 144 forbidden triples and 1440 nonempty faces, independently matched by bipartite-star-forest recognition. The deterministic 670-pair face-poset matching passes acyclicity over its full 5312-edge Hasse diagram, leaving one 0-, 98 three-, and one four-cell. The signed integral Morse boundary of the remaining 4-cell is exactly zero after 191 unit cancellations with ordinal incidence signs. By Hurewicz, the 4-cell attaches nullhomotopically to the wedge of 98 three-spheres. Independent finite-field boundary ranks over F2, F3, F5 agree. Claim is finite and no infinity inference is made.

value.rationale: The balanced four-by-four rook graph is the first balanced case beyond the previously classified three-row rook family. Its general-position complex has dimension five yet retains integral homotopy in both degrees three and four, with ranks 98 and 1. Resolving this natural previously unclassified small square provides a reproducible mixed-dimensional topology benchmark, not a routine restatement of the known f-vector. The exact null attaching map is substantive information beyond published counting polynomials.
